title: How US Firms Respond to Inbound Leads
subtitle: First-response time, audit of 2,241 firms
description: Donut chart showing how 2,241 US firms respond to inbound web leads, based on the 2011 Harvard Business Review audit The Short Life of Online Sales Leads. 37% respond within 1 hour, 16% respond between 1 and 24 hours, 24% take more than 24 hours, and 23% never respond at all. Source: Oldroyd, McElheran & Elkington, Harvard Business Review, 2011.
